business_summary: Solis Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a design and build mechanical and electrical engineering contractor in Singapore. The company installs electrical-based systems, such as switchboards and switchgears, including circuit breakers, meters, protection devices, cables, and cable boxes; standby generator systems, and fuel tanks; cabling systems; circuit wiring for lighting; lightings systems, such as light fittings, emergency lightings, and building façade lightings; ceiling and wall fans, including switches, regulators, and safety devices; power supply systems, such as CCTV, security access control, and public address systems; telephone cabling systems, such as cables, conduits, accessories, and equipment; information technology systems, including cabling system for servers and data outlets; car parking systems comprising entry and exit points controlled by microprocessors, cash card readers, and related data communication systems; security systems, such as contactless card readers, door controlling systems, and emergency break glass systems; CATV systems; and lightning protection systems. It is also involved in the installation works of air-conditioning systems, including air-conditioning units, refrigerant pipework and drainage works, and requisite insulation and fittings; mechanical ventilation systems, including exhaust air fans; fire protection systems, which include fire alarm panels, heat detectors, fire sprinklers, fire hosereel, hydrant systems, and clessan gas total flooding systems; and the design and build, and/or the installations of the systems including the requisite power supply, and control system. The company serves private residential, mixed residential, and commercial developments, as well as institutional buildings. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Singapore. Solis Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of HMK Investment Holdings Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Solis Holdings Limited는 싱가포르에서 설계 및 건설 기계 및 전기 엔지니어링 계약자로 운영됩니다. 회사는 회로 차단기, 계량기, 보호 장치, 케이블 및 케이블 박스를 포함하여 배전반 및 배전반과 같은 전기 기반 시스템을 설치합니다. 대기 발전기 시스템 및 연료 탱크; 케이블링 시스템; 조명용 회로 배선; 조명 장치, 비상 조명 및 건물 외관 조명과 같은 조명 시스템; 스위치, 조절기 및 안전 장치를 포함한 천장 및 벽 팬; CCTV, 보안 출입 통제, 전관 방송 시스템 등의 전원 공급 시스템; 케이블, 도관, 부속품 및 장비와 같은 전화 케이블링 시스템; 서버 및 데이터 콘센트용 케이블링 시스템을 포함한 정보 기술 시스템; 마이크로프로세서, 현금 카드 판독기 및 관련 데이터 통신 시스템에 의해 제어되는 출입 지점으로 구성된 주차 시스템; 비접촉식 카드 리더기, 도어 제어 시스템, 비상 유리창 시스템 등의 보안 시스템; CATV 시스템; 낙뢰 보호 시스템. 에어컨 설치공사에도 참여하고 있습니다.
